mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns remain positive (>0) in >40% of cases when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a strong labor market and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by >5% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when HOUST increases by >5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by >1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when INDPRO increases by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annualized signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when GDPC1 growth >2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a strong economy with potential inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment and high interest rates
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when UNRATE < 4% and FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by >1% annualized during a monetary tightening cycle signals reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of cases when GDPC1 declines by >1% during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by >100,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by >0.2pp, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases when PAYEMS increases by >100k and UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp.
